canonical_cup_composition.clip: Each canonical PNG already has the shared cup-interior alpha clip. Place whole 183x233 transparent canvas at work origin. For order resize whole canvas to exact 151x180 then place at order target rect; never use nonzero alpha bbox as origin.

known_limitations: Single flat RGB concept has no hidden pixels behind opaque objects. Signed local inpainting fills only exposed holes.
Milk vessel interior was semi-transparent over shelf; exported boundary uses deterministic object mask and local tint/edge repair, so concealed optical background cannot be mathematically recovered.
Glyphs in concept source are not typography authority; licensed text is a separate sample layer and runtime must render text dynamically.
